description: This file defines a React functional component and context for a Toaster UI element used to display ephemeral notifications in a web application. It includes context creation, hooks, a provider component, and rendering logic for toasts with auto-dismiss and manual dismiss features.

methods.name: useToaster
methods.description: Hook to access toasts context, providing methods to dispatch notifications.

methods.name: ToasterProvider
methods.description: Component that manages toasts state and renders notification UI, providing context for child components.
